records.import_restored: The import stands again, its stock with it.
records.restored_already: Put back already: what was deleted is there again.
records.in_use: Nothing is deleted: {{records}}. Deactivate what is still in use instead.

merge.title: Merge {{what}}
merge.goes: “{{name}}” goes; what names it moves to the record kept: {{moves}}.
merge.settings: Defaults move too, except those the record kept already sets.
merge.undo_hint: The merge can be undone for 24 hours, from the message that follows or from “Recently deleted”.
merge.alias: “{{name}}” stays, switched off, and points to the record kept. What moves to the record kept: {{moves}}.
merge.alias_empty: “{{name}}” stays, switched off, and points to the record kept. Nothing moves to the record kept.
merge.alias_stays: What stays under “{{name}}”, as the books and the stock recorded it: {{stays}}.
merge.undo_hint_alias: The merge can be undone for 24 hours, from the message that follows or from “Recently deleted”, as long as nothing has been received or recorded under the record kept.

tables.delivery_note_line: {{count}} {count, plural, one {delivery note line} other {delivery note lines}}
tables.purchase_order_line: {{count}} {count, plural, one {purchase order line} other {purchase order lines}}
tables.price_list_item: {{count}} {count, plural, one {price list price} other {price list prices}}
tables.payment_instrument: {{count}} {count, plural, one {cheque or traite} other {cheques or traites}}

errors.network: The server is not answering. Try again in a moment.
errors.not_found: This delete no longer exists, or you may not put it back.
errors.no_record: Choose at least one record to delete.
errors.record_used: Nothing is deleted, because a record is still in use.
errors.restore_conflict: Nothing is put back, because a record made since takes its place (the same number, for instance), or a record it names has been deleted since.
errors.removal_final: The 24 hours are over. The delete is final.
errors.removal_restored: Put back already: what was deleted is there again.
errors.merge_into_itself: Nothing is merged, because the record kept is among those to merge.
errors.merge_cycle: Nothing is merged, because the record kept sits under one to merge. Keep the one above instead.
errors.merge_conflict: Nothing is merged, because a row moved clashes with one of the record kept.
errors.step_up_required: Nothing changed, because who you are was not confirmed.
errors.merge_alias: Nothing is merged, because one of these records was already merged into another. Choose that one instead.
errors.merge_mismatch: Nothing is merged, because these records do not describe the same thing.
errors.merge_transacted: The merge is no longer undone, because the record kept has been used since.
errors.merge_refused: Nothing is merged, because part of these records cannot go to the record kept.
errors.merge_alias_undo: The merge is not undone, because the record kept was merged into another since. Undo that merge first.

recent.title: Recently deleted
recent.intro: What you delete, merge or take away by undoing an import stays here for 24 hours, and can be put back as it was. After that, it is final.
recent.empty: Nothing was deleted in the last 24 hours.
recent.import_undone: Taken away by undoing an import:

subjects.purchase_order: {{count}} {count, plural, one {purchase order draft} other {purchase order drafts}}
subjects.payment_instrument: {{count}} {count, plural, one {cheque or traite} other {cheques or traites}}
subjects.delivery_note: {{count}} {count, plural, one {delivery note draft} other {delivery note drafts}}

mismatch.identifiers: Nothing is merged, because these records carry different registration numbers (the tax number, for instance): they are not the same.

records.traded_since: The merge is no longer undone, because the record kept appears since in {{uses}}.

merged_away.banner: This record was merged into “{{kept}}”. It stays for what already names it and is no longer changed; lists show “{{kept}}” in its place.

merge_refused.cost_pending: Nothing is merged, because a receipt of “{{reference}}” is waiting for its cost. Enter it first.
merge_refused.costs_unseen: Nothing is merged, because stock goes to the record kept at its value, and only someone who sees costs can merge it.
merge_refused.serial_held: Nothing is merged, because the record kept already has the serial number “{{code}}”.
merge_refused.lot_dated_otherwise: Nothing is merged, because the lot “{{code}}” has another date in the record kept, and a lot has one date.
